info.name: ShopEase Order Service
info.description: Needs the Authentication-signed tokens' secret, and these services running: Order 8004, User 8002, Product Catalog 8003. Set the variable jwt_secret to JWT_SECRET_KEY from .env. The collection creates its own customers' profiles and addresses and its own catalog data. Run folders top to bottom up to 'Administrator'. To test unavailability: stop the Product Catalog Service, run only the 'Catalog unavailable' folder, start it again and run 'Recovery'. Expected amounts assume the default pricing rules (18% tax, 50.00 shipping below 1000.00).

exec: // Tokens are signed here with the shared JWT secret, exactly like the Authentication Service signs them (HS256: sub, role, iat, exp).
if (!secret) { throw new Error("Set the variable jwt_secret to JWT_SECRET_KEY from .env"); }
return head + "." + body + "." + b64u(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(head + "." + body, secret));
pm.collectionVariables.set("user_a", String(100000 + Number(run.slice(-6))));   // fresh customers for every run
pm.collectionVariables.set("admin_token", sign({ sub: "1", role: "admin", iat: now, exp: now + 1800 }));
pm.collectionVariables.set("customer_a_token", sign({ sub: pm.collectionVariables.get("user_a"), role: "customer", iat: now, exp: now + 1800 }));
pm.collectionVariables.set("customer_b_token", sign({ sub: pm.collectionVariables.get("user_b"), role: "customer", iat: now, exp: now + 1800 }));

item.name: S06 Product 1: Smart Phone X, 20000 (18000 discounted), stock 20
S07 Product 2: USB Cable, 299 (199 discounted), stock 100

exec: pm.test("Backend-calculated amounts", function () { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.subtotal).to.eql("40299.00"); pm.expect(o.discount_amount).to.eql("4100.00"); pm.expect(o.tax_amount).to.eql("6515.82"); pm.expect(o.shipping_charge).to.eql("0.00"); pm.expect(o.total_amount).to.eql("42714.82"); });

pm.test("PENDING and PENDING, owner is the token user", function () { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.order_status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(o.payment_status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(String(o.user_id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("user_a")); });

pm.test("Item snapshots", function () { const i = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(i.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(i[0].product_name).to.eql("Smart Phone X"); pm.expect(i[0].unit_price).to.eql("20000.00"); pm.expect(i[0].total_price).to.eql("36000.00"); pm.expect(i[0].stock_status).to.eql("RESERVED"); });
pm.test("Shipping address snapshot", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().shipping_address.address_line_1).to.eql("12 Rose Street"); });

item.name: 08 Client-supplied user id and prices are rejected

exec: pm.test("Fields not allowed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().details.map(d => d.message)).to.eql(["Field is not allowed", "Field is not allowed"]); });

item.name: Inventory check: product p4 stock is 3

exec: pm.test("Contains order 1", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(String(j.items[0].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("order1")); });
pm.test("Message: You do not have access to this order", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("You do not have access to this order"); });
pm.test("Two items", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total_items).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.items[1].sku).to.include("-2"); });

pm.test("Filtered page", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.page_size).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.items[0].order_status).to.eql("PENDING"); });
pm.test("Message: Administrator access is required for this operation", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Administrator access is required for this operation"); });
pm.test("Explains the rule", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Invalid status change: CONFIRMED -> DELIVERED"); });
